name: netflix-auto-skip
description: High-performance open-source browser extension to automate Netflix playback interactions.

scripts.build:zip: python -c "import os, zipfile; dist_dir = 'dist'; os.makedirs(dist_dir, exist_ok=True); zip_path = os.path.join(dist_dir, 'netflix-auto-skip-v1.0.1.zip'); include = ['manifest.json', 'LICENSE', 'README.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'background/service-worker.js', 'content/content.js', 'content/content.css', 'popup/popup.html', 'popup/popup.css', 'popup/popup.js', 'icons/icon-16.png', 'icons/icon-32.png', 'icons/icon-48.png', 'icons/icon-128.png']; zipf = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [zipf.write(f, f) for f in include if os.path.exists(f)]; zipf.close(); print(f'Built: {zip_path}')"
scripts.validate: node -c background/service-worker.js && node -c content/content.js && node -c popup/popup.js

author: MPSMeridiaN
